candidate_grammar.boundary: Every finite source-bound chemical transition between complete named reactant and product organizations, conserving every elemental carrier while changing at least one registered chemical relation.
candidate_grammar.generator: Generate the literal product of source, input, output, carrier, change, orientation, record and extension choices.

excluded_inputs: no reaction dictionary, mechanism database, rate equation, Arrhenius law, equilibrium constant, measured target or V2 answer may select a candidate
no numerical zero, negative, irrational, imaginary or floating proof quantity
no free, fitted, learned or target-derived parameter
no chemical carrier may be created, copied or silently erased
an absent dependence or event is an empty structural form, never numerical zero
external target content remains inaccessible until the prediction is sealed

intended_certificate: Complete content-specific 256-form census, sole survivor, independent regeneration and post-seal source-derived IUPAC correspondence.

title: Chemical reaction as source-bound identity transformation
